scores.note: Diff: 11 trace/report format strings 0%o->%d (modbusStartAddress_, modbusLength_, offsets are int, so safe). Only affects debug output/report; ASYN_TRACEIO_DRIVER. Applies with offsets, no fuzz, builds clean.
Adds CRC_Lo/CRC_Hi to RTU CRC error trace; one-line, message only; diagnostic value for serial-line debugging only.
Adds PINI=$(PINI=NO) to aoFloat64 only (default unchanged) and reflows whitespace of every line; conflicts with F6 on same file (hunk FAILED both orders). Optional feature, no fix.
New mbbi/mbbo templates, auto-installed by Db wildcard; purely additive, no existing behaviour touched. Defect: mbbo header comment says 'mbbi'; templates only useful if facility uses them.

Real find: R3-4 readFloat64Array has a debug loop using 'offset' BEFORE getAddr() assigns it (uninitialised read) and indexes data_[offset] with errlogPrintf on every call: UB / possible OOB read plus errlog flood on every float64 array read. Patch removes loop; also (epicsUInt16) cast and std::min int casts (Windows macro fix irrelevant on Linux). Applies with offsets, builds clean 0 warnings.
DESC=$(DESC=) added to ~28 templates; metadata only, empty default no behaviour change. Large diff over many files, conflicts with F3 on aoFloat64.template.

Adds ResetStatistics bo record to statistics.template. Alone it is HARMFUL: runtime test on IOC showed 'asynPortDriver:drvUserCreate: cannot find parameter RESET_STATISTICS' and record init failure. Requires F8.

Driver: adds RESET_STATISTICS param, resetStatistics() (zeros counters and histogram), writeInt32 handler, callParamCallbacks; plus 5 OPI screens (adl/bob/edl/opi/ui) with churn (timestamps, ui CSS). Alone, the screens reference a PV that does not exist; needs F7. Modifies core driver class and header (ABI of class). Fixes one real wart: constructor init and stats reset unified. Combined F7+F8 tested: dbpf ResetStatistics returns Reset, no drvUserCreate error.
Changes configure/RELEASE only (asyn-4-45->4-46, base 7.0.8->7.0.10 with site paths /corvette); our build overrides via RELEASE.local, so no effect. Not worth carrying.

Adds P_ResetStatistics param, resetStatistics() (zeros counters, histogram; called from ctor too), writeInt32 branch, callParamCallbacks, plus OPI screens (adl/bob/edl/opi/ui). Applies and builds clean. Counter reset unlocked w.r.t. poller? writeInt32 runs under port lock as other writes; acceptable. Operator convenience, not a fault fix. Edits core driver ctor/writeInt32; moderate surface.
Only changes sample configure/RELEASE paths (asyn-4-46, base-7.0.10) to upstream developer corvette paths. Our build overrides via RELEASE.local; no effect on the pinned build. Nothing to carry.

scores.note: Trace/report format only: octal 0%o becomes %d in 10 asynPrint/report strings. No data-path change. Diff applies with offsets (no fuzz failure) and builds clean. Cosmetic diagnostic gain; note modbusStartAddress in drvModbusAsyn::report now decimal, which changes report text for any script that parses it.

One asynPrint in modbusInterpose.c readIt CRC error path now prints CRC_Lo/CRC_Hi. Two format args match two %x conversions. Only touches RTU/serial-over-TCP error trace; helps field debugging. Applies and builds clean.

Adds PINI=$(PINI=NO) to aoFloat64.template (and reformats the whole block). Default NO equals prior behavior; opt-in only. Applies alone, but rewrites every line of the file so it conflicts with F6 on the same file (patch -p1 on F6 after F3 leaves aoFloat64.template.rej). Low value, template-only.

Adds two new templates mbbi.template and mbbo.template. Additive new files; Db Makefile uses wildcard, so both install (confirmed in install/db). Not used unless a site IOC loads them; no regression surface. Cosmetic slip: mbbo comment says 'mbbi record template'.

Real value is the removal of a leftover debug loop in readFloat64Array that reads offset uninitialized (int offset declared, loop uses 'offset<modbusLength_' and data_[offset] before getAddr) and errlogPrintf's data: undefined behaviour, potential OOB read of data_ and log flooding on every float64 array read. Also explicit (epicsUInt16) cast removes out-of-range double to int conversion UB in writeFloat64Array, and std::min made int/int. Windows #undef min/max is irrelevant on Linux. Built clean; on my run the uninitialized loop did not print (garbage offset happened to be out of range), so symptom is nondeterministic. Casting size_t maxChans to int is a theoretical truncation, harmless at Modbus sizes. Core driver file but small hunks.

Adds field(DESC,"$(DESC=)") to 28 templates; default empty so behavior unchanged, sites get per-record DESC via macro. Applies to pristine, but conflicts with F3 on aoFloat64.template (one .rej). Large mechanical diff for modest convenience; a downstream carry would need resolution if F3 is also taken.

Adds ResetStatistics bo record to statistics.template. Alone it is harmful: I ran the F7-only build and loaded statistics.template; the IOC logs 'asynPortDriver:drvUserCreate: cannot find parameter RESET_STATISTICS' and 'devAsynInt32::initCommon drvUserCreate' failure for T:S:ResetStatistics, so the record is dead on every IOC that loads the template. It must be carried only together with F8.

Driver support: new RESET_STATISTICS parameter, resetStatistics() zeroing counters and histogram, writeInt32 branch, plus callParamCallbacks. Combined with F7 I ran a real IOC against a fake TCP Modbus peer: T:S:ReadOK was 68, after dbpf T:S:ResetStatistics 1 it read 20 (counter restarted), while F7 alone had no effect. Applies with small offsets, builds clean, no warnings. Diff also carries edits to 5 operator-screen formats (adl, bob, edl, opi, ui) which are generated-file churn and not needed for function. Constructor now calls resetStatistics() instead of five setIntegerParam: same effect plus zeroes the internal counters.

Edits only configure/RELEASE (ASYN path asyn-4-45 to 4-46, base-7.0.8 to 7.0.10) pointing at upstream author's /corvette paths. The ALS-U build overrides these via RELEASE.local, so it has zero effect on our build. Applies and builds clean but delivers no value.
